final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type = 'Attività scolastiche'
  AND surface_area >= 180
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D')
  AND mobility >= 71
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: User requires an energy class of C or better, so classes A1-A4, B and C are accepted. Other requested criteria (180 sqm gross floor area, capacity for 14 people, proximity to public transport, Turin location) are not energy columns and were not translated into filters here.
User prefers the property to be near public transport. Value set at the 75th percentile (70.93, rounded to 71) of the mobility distribution, since 'near' expresses a proximity need.

The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area. The capacity of 14 people is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was supplied. Energy class and proximity to public transport are not REFERENCE COLUMNS and are excluded here. The city of Turin is a geographic place handled by the Location Agent, so comune_code is not set.
